runtime_hash_definition: scripts.release.source_identity: sorted relative runtime .py/.c/.h/.rs name + NUL + complete source bytes + NUL; distinct from experiment full-source inventory and native binary hashes
accepted_scope: Source-qualified current declarations and complete multi-source evidence under the frozen authored long-history workload, with negative controls and query-requested report facts preserved.
Preserved measured project/source-coordinate isolation and legacy engineering, short-page and directory contracts.

Lower complete-directory pooled p50 in all 14 measured groups and lower warm-recall p50 in 42/49 groups; 100k interleaved archived-project cold-recall gains coexist with 37/49 cold groups becoming slower.
Bounded candidate-pool evidence assessment without universal authority or absence inference.
decision_rationale: Correctness and completeness are the primary priority. Every formerly complete case remains complete and all eight missing multi-source policies are recovered at each of seven stages. Directory and selected interleaved-archive gains justify a scoped version with the cold-recall regressions explicitly accepted as costs. This is not acceptance of every original performance or generalization goal.
objectives_not_achieved: Constant or archive-size-independent response time for fixed-size old projects: global FTS work remains and measured candidate latency grows with foreign history.
Uniform cold-recall speedup: 37/49 pooled p50 groups are slower; no universal memory reduction or statistically established production SLA.
Calibrated abstention: all 56 missing-answer configurations still return context.
Correct factual authority in arbitrary prose, unseen production correctness, LLM final-answer accuracy, and superiority over all open-source products.

formal_run2.corpus: Seven real-ingestion synthetic checkpoints, 1024/10016/50016/100000 pages, 788 projects at peak, two archived targets fixed at 16 pages, six target histories grow; explicit turn segmentation.
formal_run2.sample_definition: 64 recall questions (56 answerable, 8 missing) and 8 directory questions repeat at seven stages. 392 answerable configurations are not 392 independent questions. Each of 84 blocks has independent baseline-snapshot restoration.
formal_run2.timing_definition: Single Ubuntu24.04 hosted runner. Directory is the complete navigation/read chain. Cold deletes only recall_cache; OS/pager/helper caches not flushed. p95 nearest rank at n30 cold/directory or n90 warm. Quality failures remain failures.
limitations: Post-run1 diagnosis and retest on the same authored workload, not an independent holdout.
No external product measured at 100k in this study.
No OS/SQLite-cold claim; native hosted binary identity retained, not locally rebuilt.
Working SQLite databases excluded from original artifact; source fingerprints/generators/response proofs retained, not original DB restoration.
CPU covers worker work outside query timers; round zero includes 72 additional quality queries; RSS is process-lifetime high-water.
Run1 used a different hosted CPU; absolute run1/run2 latency is not a paired causal comparison.

earlier_directly_bound_small_diagnostics.later_runtime_change: The only later runtime delta restricts sparse project membership to no chapter/session scope; final legacy gates and formal run2 exercise that final source.

measured_candidate_ci.boundary: CI and complete MCP log evidence for the exact formal candidate, not scale acceptance, native release delivery, or publication. Run/jobs snapshots are serialized decoded API objects.
